अ: 1. अ the first letter of the alphabet
the first short vowel inherent in consonants.
2. अ (प्रगृह्य q.v.), a vocative particle ([अ अनन्त, O Viṣṇu]), T.
interjection of pity, Ah!

3. अ (before a vowel अन्, exc. अ-ऋणिन्), a prefix corresponding to Gk. ἀ, ἀν, Lat. in, Goth. and Germ. un, Eng. in or un, and having a negative or privative or contrary sense (अन्-एक not one; अन्-अन्त endless; अ-सत् not good; अ-पश्यत् not seeing)

rarely prefixed to Inf. (अ-स्वप्तुम् not to sleep, TāṇḍyaBr.) and even to forms of the finite verb (अ-स्पृहयन्ति they do not desire, BhP.; Śiś.) and to pronouns (अ-सः not he, Śiś.; अ-तद् not that, BhP.)
occasionally denoting comparison (अ-ब्राह्मण like a Brahman, T.)
sometimes disparagement (अ-यज्ञ a miserable sacrifice)
sometimes diminutiveness (cf. अ॑-कर्ण, अन्-उदरा)

rarely an expletive (cf. अ-कुप्य, अ-पूप). According to, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 161, the accent may be optionally either on the first or last syllable in certain compounds formed with अ (as अ॑-तीक्ष्ण or अ-तीक्ष्ण॑, अ॑-शुचि or अ-शुचि॑, अ॑न्-अन्न or अन्-अन्न॑)
the same applies to stems ending in तृ accentuated on the first syllable before अ is prefixed
cf. also अ॑-तूर्त and अ-तू॑र्त, अ॑-भिन्न and अ-भिन्न॑, &c.
अ 4 the base of some pronouns and pronom. forms, in अस्य, अत्र, &c.

5. अ the augment prefixed to the root in the formation of the imperfect, aorist, and conditional tenses (in the Veda often wanting, as in Homer, the fact being that originally the augment was only prefixed in principal sentences where it was accentuated, whilst it was dropped in subordinate sentences where the root-vowel took the accent).

As a prefix to verbs and their derivatives, expresses beyond, over, and, if not standing by itself, leaves the accent on the verb or its derivative; as, अति-क्रम् (√ क्रम्), to overstep, Ved. Inf. अति-क्र॑मे, (fit) to be walked on, to be passed, RV. i, 105, 16, अति-क्र॑मण n. See s.v. When prefixed to nouns, not derived from verbs, it expresses beyond, surpassing, as, अति-कश, past the whip, अति-मानुष, superhuman, &c. See s.v.
As a separable adverb or preposition (with acc.), Ved. beyond (with gen.) over, at the top of RV.; AV.
is often prefixed to nouns and adjectives, and rarely to verbs, in the sense excessive, extraordinary, intense;
in such compounds the accent is generally on अ॑ति.

अपि [cf. Gk. ἐπί Zd. api; Germ. and Eng. prefix be]
in later Sanskṛt its place seems frequently supplied by अभि.
(As a separable adv.) and, also, moreover, besides, assuredly, surely
suppose that, perhaps, Jātakam.
अपि अपि or अपि-च, as well as
न वापि or न अपिवा or न नचापि, neither, nor, चापि, (and at the beginning of a sentence) अपि-च, moreover.
is often used to express emphasis, in the sense of even, also, very
e.g. अन्यद् अपि, also another, something more
अद्यापि, this very day, even now
तथापि, even thus, notwithstanding
यद्य् अपि, even if, although
यद्यपि तथापि, although, nevertheless
न कदाचिद् अपि, never at any time: sometimes in the sense of but, only, at least e.g. मुहूर्तम् अपि, only a moment.
may be affixed to an interrogative to make it indefinite, e.g. को ऽपि, any one
कुत्रापि, anywhere.
imparts to numerals the notion of totality e.g. चतुर्णाम् अपि वर्णानाम्, of all the four castes.
may be interrogative at the beginning of a sentence.
may strengthen the original force of the Potential, or may soften the Imperative, like the English ‘be pleased to’
sometimes it is a mere expletive.
अपि तु but, but yet.
(अपि-अपि), as well-as, ib.

अभ्याचर्: अभ्य्-आ-√ चर् (pr. p. acc. pl. f. अभ्य्-आ॑-च॑रन्तीस्) to approach (with acc.), RV. viii, 96, 15; to undertake, practise, MBh. xii, 9719.
अभ्याचार: अभ्य्-आचार॑ m. approaching (as an enemy), assault, AV. x, 3, 2
अभ्याज्: अभ्य्-आज् (√ अज्), (Imper. 2. sg. -आज) to drive near, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 8 Sch.
अभ्यातन्: अभ्य्-आ-√ तन् Ā. (impf. 3. pl. -आ॑तन्वत) to take aim at, shoot, TS.
अभ्यातान: अभ्य्-आतान॑ m. pl. ‘aiming at’, N. of certain war-songs, TS.; Kauś.
अभ्यातानत्व: अभ्य्-आतान॑—त्व॑ n. the state of those war-songs, TS.
अभ्यातप्: अभ्य्-आ-√ तप् (3. pl. -तपन्ति) to torment, pain, RV. vii, 83, 5.
अभ्यातॄ: अभ्य्-आ-√ तॄ (Imper. 2. sg. -तर) to come up to (acc.), RV. viii, 75, 15.
अभ्यात्मम्: अभ्य्-आत्म॑म् ind., Ved. towards one's self, ŚBr. &c.
अभ्यात्मतरम्: अभ्यात्म—तरम् ind. more towards one's self, ĀśvŚr.
अभ्यात्माग्र: अभ्यात्माग्र mfn. having the points turned towards one's self, ĀśvGṛ.
अभ्यादा: अभ्य्-आ-√ 1. दा Ā. (rarely P. Hariv.) to seize, snatch away, (Pot. -ददीत), MBh. i, 3558=xii, 10999=xiii, 4985 : Ā. to put on (as a wreath), Hariv.;  (with वाक्यम्) to take up the word, commence to speak, MBh. v, 3384.
अभ्यादाव्य: अभ्य्-आ-दाव्य॑ m. (√ 2. दु), N. of the non-sacrificial fire which in coming close to the sacrificial one blazes up together with it, MaitrS.
अभ्यादिश्: अभ्य्-आ-√ दिश् (Intens. p. -दे॑दिशान) to aim at (in hostile manner), RV. vi, 44, 17.
अभ्याद्रु: अभ्य्-आ-√ 2. द्रु (perf. -दुद्राव) to run towards (acc.), ŚBr.
अभ्याधा: अभ्य्-आ-√ धा chiefly Ved. to lay on (fuel, &c.), VS., &c.; to place the fire upon, ŚBr. &c.
अभ्याधान: अभ्य्-आधा॑न n. laying on (fuel), ŚBr.; Kauś.
अभ्याहित: अभ्य्-आ॑हित a mfn. laid on (as fuel), ŚBr.; ChUp.
अभ्याहितपशु: अभ्य्-आ॑हित—पशु m. a present or duty (usual in some districts of India), Pāṇ. vi, 3, 10 Sch.
अभ्याहिताग्नि: अभ्य्-आहिताग्नि mfn. (a house) containing a sacred fire, MānGṛ.
अभ्यानन: अभ्य्-आनन mfn. having the face turned towards, BhP.
अभ्यानन्द्य: अभ्या-नन्द्य ind. having thanked and praised, Divyâv.
अभ्यानी: अभ्य्-आ-√ नी (ind.p. -नीय) to pour into, mix with, AitBr.
अभ्यानृत्: अभ्य्-आ-√ नृत् (pr. p. -नृ॑त्यत्) to dance towards, hasten near, TBr.
अभ्याप्: अभ्य्-√ आप् -आप्नो॑ति, to reach to, get, obtain, ŚBr. : Caus. -आप॑यति, to bring to an end, ŚBr. : Desid. P. अभीप्सति (rarely Ā. MBh. v, 17), to strive to reach, ask for, desire, MBh. &c.
अभीप्सत्: अभीप्सत् mf(अती, MBh. i, 6469; R.; अन्ती, Mn. v, 156)n. (pr.p.) longing for, desiring.
अभीप्सु: अभीप्सु mfn. id. (with acc. N. &c.; with Inf. Śiś. i, 14).
अभ्यापत्: अभ्य्-आ-√ पत् to jump on, hasten near to, rush towards (acc. without or with प्रति), MBh.; Kathās. : Caus. to extend (a string) towards (acc.), Śulb.
अभ्यापद्: अभ्य्-आ-√ पद् (Pot. -पद्येत) to enter into, come to (acc.), ĀśvGṛ.
अभ्यापादम्: अभ्य्-आ-पादम् ind. so as to enter into or pass through (acc.), Nir. vii, 26.
अभ्याभू: अभ्य्-आ-√ भू (Pot. -भ॑वेत्) to happen to, occur to (acc.), ŚBr.; AitBr.
अभ्यायम्: अभ्य्-आ-√ यम् P. (3. pl. -यच्छन्ति) to lengthen (as a syllable in speaking), AitBr.; to draw or pull (as the udder in sucking), Kāṭh. : Ā. (Imper. 2. sg. -यच्छस्व) to assume (‘to grant’ Comm.), VS. iii, 38 : P. (Subj. 3. pl. -यमन्; ind.p. -य॑त्य) to aim at, RV. viii, 92, 31; ŚBr.; AitBr.;  for अभ्य्-आ-√ गम्, KauṣBr.
अभ्यायंसेन्य: अभ्य्-आ-यंसे॑न्य mfn. (said of the Aśvins) one who allows himself to be drawn near (for accepting the sacrificial oblation), RV. i, 34, 1.
अभ्याया: अभ्य्-आ-√ या to come up to, approach, MBh. &c.
अभ्यायु: अभ्य्-आ-√ 2. यु Ā. (3. pl. -युवते) to strive towards (acc.), AitBr.
अभ्यारभ्: अभ्य्-आ-√ रभ् Ā. to lay hold of (acc.), ŚBr.; AitBr. : P. (impf. -आरभत्) to commence, MBh. iii, 10724.
अभ्यारम्: अभ्य्-आ॑रम् ind. (cf. आर॑) near, at hand, RV. viii, 72, 11.
अभ्यारुह्: अभ्य्-आ-√ रुह् -आ॑-रोहति, to ascend, mount, step upon, AV.; TS.; ŚBr. : Caus. (Subj. 1. sg. -रोह॑याणि) to cause to ascend, ŚBr.
अभ्यारूढ: अभ्य्-आ॑रूढ mfn. ascended, TS. (cf. अ॑न्- neg.)
अभ्यारोहणीय: अभ्य्-आरोहणीय m. N. of a sacrificial ceremony, ĀśvŚr.; Lāṭy.
अभ्यावध्: अभ्य्-आ-√ वध् (aor. -आवधीत्) to strike, R. i, 45, 17 (v.l.)
अभ्यावह्: अभ्य्-आ-√ वह् (3. pl. Imper. -वहन्तु and impf. -अवहन्) to convey, bring towards (acc.), RV. i, 51, 10, 134, 1 and vi, 63, 7.
अभ्याविश्: अभ्य्-आ-√ विश् (impf. -आविशत्) to rush into (acc.), MBh. vii, 5812;  P. Ā. to enter into, penetrate, MBh.
अभ्यावृत्: अभ्य्-आ-√ वृत् -व॑र्तते (Imper. 2. sg. -ववृत्स्व; P. impf. 3. sg. -आवर्त् [RV. vii, 59, 4]) to roll (as a cart) towards, come up to or towards (acc.), approach, RV.; AV.; VS. : Caus. (Ved.) -ववर्तति id., RV. x, 64, 1;  -वर्तयति, to repeat, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
अभ्यावर्तम्: अभ्य्-आ-व॑र्तम् ind. so as to repeat, repeatedly, ŚBr.; PBr.
अभ्यावर्तिन्: अभ्य्-आवर्ति॑न् mfn. coming near, coming repeatedly, VS. (voc.), Kauś.
अभ्य्-आवर्तिन् m. N. of a king (son of Cāyamāna and descendant of Pṛthu), RV. vi, 27, 5 and 8.
अभ्यावृत्त: अभ्य्-आ॑वृत्त mfn. come near, approached, VS. viii, 58
अभ्यावृत्य: अभ्य्-आ-वृत्य ind.p. turning one's self towards (acc.), MBh. v, 4128.
अभ्यासक्त: अभ्य्-आ-सक्त mfn. (√ सञ्ज्), closely linked together (as days by beginning a day with the same ceremony which has been performed at the end of the preceding day), ĀśvŚr. Comm. on PBr.
अभ्यासङ्ग्य: अभ्य्-आसङ्ग्य mfn. to be closely linked together (as days; See before), PBr.; Vait.
अभ्य्-आसङ्ग्य m. N. of a Pañcāha, PBr.; ĀpŚr.
अभ्यासद्: अभ्य्-आ-√ सद् (Ved. Inf. -स॑दम्) to sit down into (acc.), RV. ix, 3, 1 and 30, 4; to attain, obtain, Kir. v, 52.
अभ्यासादन: अभ्य्-आसादन n. attacking an enemy, L.
अभ्यासादयितव्य: अभ्य्-आसादयितव्य mfn. to be allowed to approach, MBh. iii, 17101.
अभ्यासिच्: अभ्य्-आ-√ सिच् to pour on Gobh.; Suśr.
अभ्याहन्: अभ्य्-आ-√ हन् (Imper. 2. sg. -जहि॑; perf. Ā. -जघ्ने) to strike, wound, RV. ix, 85, 2; MBh.; ChUp.; to impede (Inf. -हनितुम्), Hariv.
अभ्याहनन: अभ्य्-आहनन n. impeding, interruption Comm. on PBr.
अभ्याहृ: अभ्य्-आ-√ हृ to bring near, hand over, MBh.; R.; to carry off, R. ed. Bomb. i, 61, 7.
अभ्याह्वे: अभ्य्-आ-√ ह्वे -ह्व॑यते, to address (with the आहाव formula), TS.; ŚBr.; AitBr.;  (pr. p. -ह्वयत्) to shout at, challenge, attack, PBr.
अभ्युक्त: अभ्य्-उक्त mfn. declared or uttered (as a verse) with reference to (acc.), ŚBr.; Up.
अभ्युक्ष्: अभ्य्-√ 1. उक्ष् P. -उक्ष॑ति, (ind.p. -उक्ष्य) to sprinkle over, besprinkle, ŚBr. and c.: Ā. (perf. -ववक्षे) to cover with sparks, RV. i, 146, 2.
अभ्युक्षण: अभ्य्-उक्षण n. sprinkling over, wetting, KātyŚr.; Lāṭy.; Ragh. xvi, 57.
अभ्युच्: अभ्य्-√ उच् -उच्यति, to like, take pleasure in visiting, TS.
अभ्युच्चर्: अभ्य्-उच्-√ चर् (Imper. 2. sg. -चरा) to rise over (acc.), RV. viii, 25, 21.
अभ्युच्चि: अभ्य्-उच्-√ 1. चि to bring together in one place Comm. on Bād.; to treat (a subject) in connection with (another), ib.
अभ्युच्चित: अभ्य्-उच्चित mfn. increased Comm. on Nir.
अभ्युच्छ्रय: अभ्य्-उच्छ्रय m. (√ श्रि), ‘elevation’, in comp. with
अभ्युच्छ्रयवत्: अभ्य्-उच्छ्रय—वत् mfn. having a great elevation, being higher than (abl.), MBh. iii, 11699.
अभ्युच्छ्रित: अभ्य्-उ॑च्छ्रित mfn. raised aloft, elevated, ŚBr. &c.
अभ्युच्छ्रितकर: अभ्य्-उ॑च्छ्रित—कर mfn. with uplifted proboscis, MBh. iii, 15735.
अभ्युज्जि: अभ्य्-उज्-√ जि to obtain by conquering, GopBr.
अभ्युज्जीव्: अभ्य्-उज्-√ जीव् -जीवति, to preserve life, MBh. v, 4538.
अभ्युज्ज्वल्: अभ्य्-उज्-√ ज्वल् Caus. -ज्वलयति, to inflame, BaudhP.
अभ्युत्क्रम्: अभ्य्-उत्-√ क्रम् to go upto, ascend, Vait. : P. (fut. 1. pl. -क्रमिष्यामस्, ŚBr.) and Caus. P. -क्रमयति ([ŚBr.]) or -क्रामयति ([ĀśvGṛ.]) to cause to go or step towards (loc.)
अभ्युत्क्रुश्: अभ्य्-उत्-√ क्रुश् (Subj. 1. pl. -क्रोशाम) to raise loud acclamations towards (acc.), AitBr.
अभ्युत्क्रुष्ट: अभ्य्-उत्क्रुष्ट mfn. applauded with loud acclamations, AitBr. (अन्- neg.)
अभ्युत्क्रोशन: अभ्य्-उत्क्रोशन n. loud acclamation, Sāy. on AitBr.
अभ्युत्क्रोशनमन्त्र: अभ्य्-उत्क्रोशन—मन्त्र m. a hymn of applause (with which Indra is addressed), ib.
अभ्युत्तॄ: अभ्य्-उत्-√ तॄ (3. pl. -उ॑त्-तरन्ति) to cross, ŚBr.;  (1. pl. -तरेम) to cross over towards, penetrate to (acc.), RV. x, 53, 8.
अभ्युत्था: अभ्य्-उत्-था (√ स्था), (impf. -उ॑दतिष्ठत्; perf. -उ॑त्-तस्थौ) to rise for going towards (acc.), AV. xv, 8, 5; ŚBr. &c.; to rise from a seat to do any one (acc.) honour, Śāk. &c.;  (with आतिथ्य-कर्म) id., MBh. viii, 634; to rise in rebellion, MārkP.; to leave off, desist from (abl.) Comm. on ChUp.
अभ्युत्थान: अभ्य्-उत्थान n. rising from a seat through politeness, Pañcat.
elevation, gaining a high position, gaining authority, respectability, Bhag.; Ragh.
(said of destiny) gaining efficacy, power, MBh. xiii, 343
अभ्युत्थायिन्: अभ्य्-उत्थायिन् mfn. rising from a seat to do any one honour Comm. on KātyŚr. (अन्- neg.)
अभ्युत्थित: risen from the seat to do any one (acc.) honour, Hariv.; BhP.
risen for doing anything, making one's self ready for (acc.), Nir.
अभ्युत्थिति: अभ्य्-उत्थिति f. rising from a seat, Naiṣ.
अभ्युत्थेय: अभ्य्-उत्थेय mfn. to be greeted reverentially (i.e. by rising from one's seat) Comm. on KātyŚr.
अभ्युत्पत्: अभ्य्-उत्-√ पत् (p. -पतत्; perf. -पपात) to fly or jump or rush up to (acc.), Hariv.; Kathās. : Caus. -उ॑त्-पातयति, to cause to fly up to (acc.), ŚBr.
अभ्युत्पतन: अभ्य्-उत्पतन n. springing or leaping against any one, Ragh. ii, 27.
अभ्युत्सद्: अभ्य्-उत्-√ सद् Caus. (Ved. aor. -सादयाम् अकः [अकर्, √ 1. कृ]) to cause to set out towards (acc.; for obtaining), MaitrS. (quoted by, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 42).
अभ्युत्सर्ज्: अभ्य्-उत्-√ सर्ज् (Pot. -उ॑त्-सर्जेत्) to rattle towards (acc.), TS.
अभ्युत्सह्: अभ्य्-उत्-√ सह् to be able to resist (with acc.), MBh. vi, 2351; to feel competent, venture (with Inf.), MBh. iii, 13206; Ragh. v, 22.
अभ्युत्सिच्: अभ्य्-उत्-√ सिच् (ind.p. -सि॑च्य) to fill up by pouring, ŚBr.; to sprinkle with (instr., अद्भिस्), ŚāṅkhGṛ.
अभ्युत्सृज्: अभ्य्-उत्-√ सृज् to throw (as an arrow) towards (dat.), MBh. vii, 8852 : Desid. (p. -सिसृक्षत्) to be about to give up (as one's life), MBh. xii, 833.
अभ्युत्स्मि: अभ्य्-उत्-√ स्मि (only p. -स्मयत्) to smile on (acc.), smile, MBh.; Hariv.
अभ्युद्: अभ्य्-√ उद् (p. -उन्द॑त्; Imper. 2. pl. -उन॑त्त [for उन्त्त॑ see Whitney's Gr. section 690]) to wet, flow over, RV.; ŚBr.; AitBr.
अभ्युदन्: अभ्य्-उद्-√ अन् -अ॑निति, to breathe towards or upon (acc.), ŚBr.
अभ्युदवसो: अभ्य्-उद्-अव-√ सो -स्यति, to set out or go towards (acc.), AitBr.
अभ्युदानी: अभ्य्-उद्-आ-√ नी to lead up (out of water), MānŚr.; MānGṛ.; Gobh. (cf. उद्-आ√ नी); to fetch out from, MānŚr.
अभ्युदाहृ: अभ्य्-उद्-आ-√ हृ to give an example in addition, Āp.
अभ्युदाहरण: अभ्य्-उदाहरण n. an example or illustration of a thing by its reverse, L.
अभ्युदि: अभ्य्-उद्-√ इ (2. sg. -एषि; Imper. 2. sg. -उ॑द्-इहि; Pot. -इयात् [ŚBr.], -ईयात् [MBh. iii, 2010 and 10272]; fut. -उद्-अयिष्यति, MBh. iv, 688), (said of the sun) to rise over (acc.), rise, RV. viii, 93, 1; AV. &c.; to engage in combat with (acc.), MBh. (Pot. -ईयात् See before); to finish off at (acc.), PBr.
अभ्युदय: अभ्य्-उदय m. sunrise or rise of luminaries (during or with reference to some other occurrence), KātyŚr.; Jaim.
elevation, increase, prosperity, happiness, good result, Mn. iii, 254; R. &c.
a religious celebration, festival, Mn. ix, 84.
अभ्युदयेष्टि: अभ्युदयेष्टि f. N. of an expiatory sacrifice, Jaim. (cf. अभ्युदितेष्टि.)
अभ्युदित: 1. अभ्य्-उदित mfn. risen (as the sun or luminaries), MBh.; R.; Mn. iv, 104
one over whom (while sleeping) the sun has risen, Mn. ii, 221 Comm. on TS.
अभ्यु॑दित n. (said of the sun or the moon) rising (during some other occurrence), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
2. अभ्य्-उदित mfn. (√ वद्), expressed (in words), KenaUp. (अन्- neg.)
अभ्युदिता: अभ्य्-उदिता f. N. of the ceremony (to be performed at the अभ्यु॑दित), KauṣBr.
अभ्युदितशायिता: अभ्य्-उदित—शायि-ता f. the state of lying asleep while the sun has risen, MBh. xiii, 5093.
अभ्युदीक्ष्: अभ्य्-उद्-√ ईक्ष् Ā. (impf. -ऐक्षत) to look towards (acc.), R.
अभ्युदीर्: अभ्य्-उद्-√ ईर् Caus. (p. -ईरयत्) to raise (one's voice), MBh. i, 2570 : Pass. -ईर्यते, to be stirred up, be intensified, Suśr.
अभ्युदीरिते: अभ्य्-उदीरि°ते ind. loc. after it had been said by (instr.), Kathās.
अभ्युदूह्: अभ्य्-उद्-√ 1. ऊह् (impf. औहत्) to move or push farther out, AitBr.
अभ्युदे: अभ्य्-उद्-ए (√ इ), (ind.p. -ए॑त्य) to go out in order to meet any one (acc.), AV. xv, 11, 2 and 12, 2.
अभ्युद्ग: अभ्य्-उद्ग mfn. fr. √ उब्ज्, Pat. on Pāṇ. Śivasūtra 5 and viii, 3, 38.
अभ्युद्गत: one who has gone out in order to meet any one (acc.), MBh. i, 3572
अभ्युद्गतराज: अभ्य्-उद्-गत—राज m. N. of a Kalpa, Buddh.
अभ्युद्गति: अभ्य्-उद्गति f. going to meet, Daś.
